mathematical_result.statement: For Q=2XY+Z^2 with independent cap-one inputs and radial coarea slices J_rho(q)=int f_X(q/(2y)-rho^2 y/2)f_Y(y)f_Z(rho y)dy, there is no law-independent w in L1([2,infinity)) dominating J_rho(q) a.e. for every admissible product law and every q.
mathematical_result.interpretation: The dangerous curved trace is a moving stationary ridge. A universal per-radius integrable majorant is impossible; the proof must integrate rho jointly before taking the output supremum.

partner_result_applied.actual_application: The stress matrix [[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]] has sigma_min=1, so the theorem gives ||p_(2XY+Z^2)||_infinity<36 for the constructed laws.
